name: Constants
description: Fields of the type that its create sets and nothing changes after: an update that changes one, a caller's or one a behavior's operation applies, is refused at the field, unless the caller holds the config's permission. A field the create leaves absent stays absent. What routes an instance, such as a step's kind or the key a blueprint stamped it with, stays what its create gave it.

fields.description: The type's own top-level fields, by JSON key, that keep the value their create gives them.

permission.description: The permission a caller needs to change them after the create; nobody may when absent.
